# Semi Design System (@semi/ui v0.10.0)

> The shared UI of every Semi app: semantic tokens that work in light and dark mode, React components (Next.js, Tailwind CSS 4) and the rules agents follow. Every component has a page with live examples and a markdown twin for agents.

Install `@semi/ui`, import components from `@semi/ui`, class constants from `@semi/ui/styles`, CSS `@semi/ui/tokens.css` + `@semi/ui/base.css`. Before writing UI read QUICK_REF.md; pick the component from docs/components/README.md, read its page, copy an example; never invent local colours, sizes or wrapper components; check with `npx semi-lint`.

## Machine-readable

- [components.json](./components.json): all 98 components, hooks and constants with props, summaries and their doc page
- [docs/components/README.md](./docs/components/README.md): every component doc by group, with when to use it
- [QUICK_REF.md](./docs/QUICK_REF.md): Quick reference: the rules and imports to read before any UI change
- [DESIGN_SYSTEM.md](./docs/DESIGN_SYSTEM.md): Full design system rules (layout, colour, components, accessibility, anti-patterns)
- [COMPONENT_DOCS.md](./docs/COMPONENT_DOCS.md): How the component docs are built (examples/, meta.json, generated API) and how agents should use them
- [ICONS.md](./docs/ICONS.md): Semantic icon guide: which icon means what
- [BRANDS.md](./docs/BRANDS.md): Brands: brand kits (brand.json → brand.css), the step-by-step flow from a new brand to its first product, which command when
- [STYLES.md](./docs/STYLES.md): Styles (Flat, Soft, Sharp) and palettes: what each changes, how an app picks one
- [agent-rules.md](./docs/agent-rules.md): Rules block for a consumer app's AGENTS.md / CLAUDE.md
- [tokens.css](./docs/tokens.css): Generated design tokens (CSS variables for both themes)
- [llms-full.txt](./llms-full.txt): this file followed by all the docs above and every component doc

## Pages

- [Introduction](./): what Semi is, install, resources for agents
- [Components](./components/): every component with a live example
- [Foundations](./foundations/): surface tokens, type scale, icon registry
- [Brand preview](./brand/): preview a brand on every page before creating its kit

## Components

### Actions

- [Button](./components/button/) ([markdown](./docs/components/button.md)): The action control: one primary per area, secondary for the rest, danger for destructive actions, ghost for quiet ones. Spinner shows work in progress inside the control that runs it. Components: Button, Spinner.
- [Button group](./components/button-group/) ([markdown](./docs/components/button-group.md)): Joins related buttons into one segmented control: shared borders, outer corners only (‹ Hôm nay ›, Lưu | ▾). Components: ButtonGroup.
- [Chip](./components/chip/) ([markdown](./docs/components/chip.md)): A pill-shaped toggle for filters and tags. Neutral when off; active uses the high-contrast surface, with colour only on its dot or icon (tone). Components: Chip.
- [External link](./components/external-link/) ([markdown](./docs/components/external-link.md)): A link to another site: opens a new tab on desktop and the external browser inside a mobile WebView, with an external-link icon. Components: ExternalLink.
- [Pills](./components/pills/) ([markdown](./docs/components/pills.md)): A single-choice filter of 2–5 options on one track (segmented look). The left side of a SubpageToolbar. Components: Pills.
- [Toggle](./components/toggle/) ([markdown](./docs/components/toggle.md)): Buttons that stay pressed. Toggle for one (pin, mute, bold); ToggleGroup for a set of icon or short options, one or several at a time (list / grid view, text styles). Components: Toggle, ToggleGroup.

### Forms

- [Calendar](./components/calendar/) ([markdown](./docs/components/calendar.md)): A month grid to pick one day or a range (YYYY-MM-DD, weeks start on Monday). DatePicker shows it in a popover; place it inline for schedules and report filters. Components: Calendar.
- [Checkbox](./components/checkbox/) ([markdown](./docs/components/checkbox.md)): A native checkbox with label and description, checked fill in the accent, and an indeterminate state for “select all”. Components: Checkbox.
- [Combobox](./components/combobox/) ([markdown](./docs/components/combobox.md)): CustomCombobox: type to filter a long list, then pick one value. Components: CustomCombobox.
- [Date picker](./components/date-picker/) ([markdown](./docs/components/date-picker.md)): A date field with a Calendar popover (YYYY-MM-DD, min / max). Never type="date". Components: DatePicker.
- [Field, Input, Textarea](./components/field/) ([markdown](./docs/components/field.md)): Field gives any control a label, a hint and an error, wired for screen readers. Input and Textarea are the standard text controls (bg-field, h-field). Components: Field, Input, Textarea.
- [Input group](./components/input-group/) ([markdown](./docs/components/input-group.md)): An input with fixed parts around it: a prefix (https://), a unit (kg, ₫), an icon or a small button (copy, show password). Components: InputGroup.
- [Number input](./components/number-input/) ([markdown](./docs/components/number-input.md)): NumberInput: numbers with a touch keypad (NumPadPopup) on phones and tablets, plain typing elsewhere. Never type="number". Components: NumberInput, NumPadPopup.
- [Radio group](./components/radio-group/) ([markdown](./docs/components/radio-group.md)): Exactly one option of a few, each with an optional description; vertical by default. Components: RadioGroup.
- [Search input](./components/search-input/) ([markdown](./docs/components/search-input.md)): The toolbar search: an icon button that opens into a field (clear button, h-control); it collapses again when empty and focus leaves. SubpageToolbar includes one. Components: SearchInput.
- [Select](./components/select/) ([markdown](./docs/components/select.md)): CustomSelect: pick one value from a list, in a field, in a toolbar, inline in a row or bare. Never the native <select>. Components: CustomSelect.
- [Slider](./components/slider/) ([markdown](./docs/components/slider.md)): Pick a number in a range by dragging: one thumb, or two with range for a min–max pair. Components: Slider.
- [Switch](./components/switch/) ([markdown](./docs/components/switch.md)): An on / off toggle for settings that apply immediately. Components: Switch.

### Overlays

- [Command](./components/command/) ([markdown](./docs/components/command.md)): A command palette: type to filter actions and pages, ↑/↓ to move, Enter to run. Command is the inline list; CommandDialog opens it over the page, usually on ⌘K (useHotkey). Matching ignores case and Vietnamese marks. Components: Command, CommandDialog.
- [Confirm dialog](./components/confirm-dialog/) ([markdown](./docs/components/confirm-dialog.md)): confirmDialog() asks one yes / no question and resolves to true or false. Mount ConfirmHost once in the root layout. Never window.confirm. Components: ConfirmHost.
- [Context menu](./components/context-menu/) ([markdown](./docs/components/context-menu.md)): The menu of an area opened at the pointer: right-click, long-press on touch, or the Menu key / Shift+F10 when the area has focus. Components: ContextMenu.
- [Drawer](./components/drawer/) ([markdown](./docs/components/drawer.md)): A panel that slides in from the right, left, bottom or top (a sheet), with title and footer. Components: Drawer.
- [Hover card](./components/hover-card/) ([markdown](./docs/components/hover-card.md)): A preview card while the pointer rests on, or focus is on, a link: a person, a product, an order. Components: HoverCard.
- [Menu](./components/menu/) ([markdown](./docs/components/menu.md)): The overflow menu of a row or card: a ⋯ trigger (or your own) with items, icons, separators and a danger item last. Components: Menu.
- [Modal](./components/modal/) ([markdown](./docs/components/modal.md)): The shared dialog: full screen on phones, a centred panel from sm up, with title, description, body and footer. Focus is trapped and returns to the opener. Components: Modal.
- [Popover](./components/popover/) ([markdown](./docs/components/popover.md)): A small non-modal panel under its trigger for interactive content: a quick form, filters, a picker. Components: Popover.
- [Toast](./components/toast/) ([markdown](./docs/components/toast.md)): toast() shows a short message after an action, with a tone and an optional action (Hoàn tác). Mount ToastHost once in the root layout. Components: ToastHost.
- [Tooltip](./components/tooltip/) ([markdown](./docs/components/tooltip.md)): A short label on hover or focus, mostly for icon-only buttons. Components: Tooltip.

### Navigation & layout

- [App header](./components/app-header/) ([markdown](./docs/components/app-header.md)): The top bar of a stand-alone tool app: logo + title go home, the module name, and one primary action on the right. No Home button. Components: AppHeader.
- [App shell](./components/app-shell/) ([markdown](./docs/components/app-shell.md)): The frame of a multi-page app: a floating bento sidebar (w-52, collapses to a w-14 icon rail) on bg-canvas, the content panel beside it, and MobileTabBar at the bottom on phones. This docs site is an AppShell. Components: AppShell, MobileTabBar.
- [Breadcrumb](./components/breadcrumb/) ([markdown](./docs/components/breadcrumb.md)): Where the page sits: a trail of links ending with the current page. Long trails collapse their middle into a “…” menu. Components: Breadcrumb.
- [Page actions](./components/page-actions/) ([markdown](./docs/components/page-actions.md)): Lets a page put its actions into a slot of the shared header: PageActionsProvider wraps the layout, PageActionsSlot marks where they render, PageActions sends them from the page. Components: PageActions, PageActionsProvider, PageActionsSlot.
- [Page title](./components/page-title/) ([markdown](./docs/components/page-title.md)): PageTitle is the large display title of a page (text only). PageTabsTitle turns it into 2–4 underline tabs for sibling pages. Components: PageTitle, PageTabsTitle.
- [Pagination](./components/pagination/) ([markdown](./docs/components/pagination.md)): Page numbers with previous / next for long tables. For card lists prefer auto-loading with “Xem thêm”. Components: Pagination.
- [Scroll area](./components/scroll-area/) ([markdown](./docs/components/scroll-area.md)): A fixed-size scrolling region (a long list in a card, a log). Semi hides scrollbars, so it marks the edges that have more content, can show a thin scrollbar, and is reachable by keyboard. Components: ScrollArea.
- [Side panel](./components/side-panel/) ([markdown](./docs/components/side-panel.md)): A 320px tool panel beside a canvas that collapses to a 48px rail; SidePanelToggle is its collapse button. Components: SidePanel, SidePanelToggle.
- [Subpage toolbar](./components/subpage-toolbar/) ([markdown](./docs/components/subpage-toolbar.md)): The sticky row under a page title: filters on the left; search, refresh and the icon-only primary action on the right. RefreshButton spins while its promise runs. Components: SubpageToolbar, RefreshButton.
- [Tabs](./components/tabs/) ([markdown](./docs/components/tabs.md)): Switch between panels of content inside a page or card: underline (default) or segmented, with icons and counts. Components: Tabs.

### Data display

- [Accordion](./components/accordion/) ([markdown](./docs/components/accordion.md)): A list of sections where one (or several) open at a time: FAQs, settings groups, help. Components: Accordion.
- [Avatar](./components/avatar/) ([markdown](./docs/components/avatar.md)): A person or team: their image, or initials on a tone picked from the name. Components: Avatar.
- [Badge](./components/badge/) ([markdown](./docs/components/badge.md)): A read-only status or tag in a tone (10% fill, 20% border, theme-safe text), with an optional dot or icon. Components: Badge.
- [Card](./components/card/) ([markdown](./docs/components/card.md)): The bento content card: panel fill and the style's card border, radius and resting shadow. interactive adds hover / press, active marks the selected or running item. Components: Card.
- [Collapsible](./components/collapsible/) ([markdown](./docs/components/collapsible.md)): One section that opens and closes under its trigger row (advanced options, details of a log line). Components: Collapsible.
- [Data table](./components/data-table/) ([markdown](./docs/components/data-table.md)): A table that sorts, filters, selects and pages rows on the client, built on Table: give it rows and columns, it keeps the state (or you control it). Components: DataTable.
- [Icon](./components/icon/) ([markdown](./docs/components/icon.md)): The semantic icon registry (stroke 1.75, 24px grid). IconTile is the rounded tinted square that leads cards and dialogs. Components: Icon, IconTile.
- [Kbd](./components/kbd/) ([markdown](./docs/components/kbd.md)): A key or a shortcut (⌘ K, Ctrl Enter) as key caps, for menus, tooltips, the command palette and help text. Components: Kbd.
- [KPI card](./components/kpi-card/) ([markdown](./docs/components/kpi-card.md)): A metric card: label, a large tabular figure, a sub line coloured good / danger, and an icon in its tone. Components: KpiCard.
- [Markdown](./components/markdown/) ([markdown](./docs/components/markdown.md)): Renders AI or user text safely: paragraphs, lists, bold, inline code and links (as ExternalLink). No HTML. Components: Markdown.
- [Separator](./components/separator/) ([markdown](./docs/components/separator.md)): A thin divider between groups of content: horizontal, vertical, or with a short label in the middle (“hoặc”). Components: Separator.
- [Table](./components/table/) ([markdown](./docs/components/table.md)): A dense table for rows compared column by column. Cells stay on one line (the table scrolls sideways on phones); TD wrap for a long-text column, numeric for figures. Components: Table, THead, TBody, TR, TH, TD.

### Feedback

- [Alert](./components/alert/) ([markdown](./docs/components/alert.md)): A message that stays on the page: info, success, warning, danger, with a title, an action and an optional dismiss. Components: Alert.
- [Empty state](./components/empty-state/) ([markdown](./docs/components/empty-state.md)): What an empty list or page shows: an icon, one short title, a description and the action that fills it. Components: EmptyState.
- [Progress](./components/progress/) ([markdown](./docs/components/progress.md)): A determinate bar with value, or an indeterminate one when the end is unknown; tones for success and danger. Components: Progress.
- [Skeleton](./components/skeleton/) ([markdown](./docs/components/skeleton.md)): Shimmer placeholders while content loads: Skeleton blocks, SkeletonCard, SkeletonGrid, SkeletonRows, PageSkeleton; Loading announces the region. Never “Đang tải…” text. Components: Skeleton, SkeletonCard, SkeletonGrid, SkeletonRows, PageSkeleton, Loading.

### AI

- [AI chat](./components/ai-chat/) ([markdown](./docs/components/ai-chat.md)): AIChat is the ready-made assistant panel: ChatPanel (side panel or full screen, resizable, keyboard inset) around ChatView (list + composer). UI only: the app keeps the messages, streams the answer and calls the model. Components: AIChat, ChatPanel, ChatView.
- [Chat messages](./components/chat-messages/) ([markdown](./docs/components/chat-messages.md)): The parts of a conversation, to compose your own chat: UserMessage, AssistantMessage (+ ChatAnswer for a ChatItem), ChatThinking, ChatError, ChatCopyButton, ChatAvatar, ChatIntro, ChatSuggestion(s), ChatList and ChatComposer. Components: UserMessage, AssistantMessage, ChatAnswer, ChatAvatar, ChatCopyButton, ChatError, ChatThinking, ChatIntro, ChatSuggestion, ChatSuggestions, ChatList, ChatComposer.
- [Chat model picker](./components/chat-model-picker/) ([markdown](./docs/components/chat-model-picker.md)): Provider → model → effort chips, for the toolbar of a chat composer. The lists are app data. Components: ChatModelPicker.

### Setup

- [Locale](./components/locale/) ([markdown](./docs/components/locale.md)): SemiLocaleProvider sets the UI strings of every Semi component (Vietnamese by default, English shipped, override any string). Components: SemiLocaleProvider.
- [Theme](./components/theme/) ([markdown](./docs/components/theme.md)): Light / dark / system: ThemeScript applies the stored theme before paint, ThemeProvider keeps it, ThemeSwitcher (three-way) and ThemeToggle switch it. data-theme on any element re-scopes every token inside it. Components: ThemeProvider, ThemeScript, ThemeSwitcher, ThemeToggle.
